## Boards as text

- The newest board, as text, in parts that each name the next: {{ site }}/latest.md
- The newest board, as JSON: {{ site }}/latest.json
- Any board day's board, as text, with its later parts board-2.md and on: {{ site }}/days/<board day>/board.md
- Any board day's board, as JSON: {{ site }}/days/<board day>/board.json
- A board day is written as {{ newest_day }}, and the first board day is {{ first_day }}
- The list of board days: {{ site }}{{ days_address }}
- The list of every repository that has been on a board, one line each: {{ site }}/repos.tsv
